missions.phrase: Наш шеф сегодня в хорошем настроении.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Шеф' is nominative as the subject. 'Наш' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'в хорошем настроении' describes his mood.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Шефа' takes the genitive-like accusative because it is animate masculine. 'Нашего' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a possession frame. 'Шефа' is genitive after 'у', marking whose meeting it is. 'Встреча' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Шефу' is dative as the person called, governed by 'позвонил'. 'Утром' is an instrumental adverb of time.

missions.phrase: Я говорил с шефом о зарплате.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Шефом' is instrumental after 'с', marking the person spoken with. 'О зарплате' is prepositional, naming the topic.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Шефе' is prepositional after 'о', marking the topic of discussion. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Шефа' uses the animate accusative, identical to the genitive. 'Своего' agrees, and 'сотрудники' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Шеф' is nominative as the subject of 'похвалил'. 'Меня' is the accusative object, and 'перед коллегами' is instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Шефы' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Строгие' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в компании' gives the setting.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Шеф' is nominative as the subject. 'Требовательный' is the agreeing masculine predicate adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
